typical_direction_or_pattern: Mixed: higher Monetary generally pushes away from Churn, while higher AverageOrderValue generally pushes toward Churn.
managerial_meaning: Observed customer value and order-value intensity.
what_to_monitor: Monitor value and order-value patterns without assuming higher value causes retention.
causal_guardrail: Prediction signal only; no causal intervention effect is established.

typical_direction_or_pattern: Predominantly away from Churn: Frequency and TotalQuantity show negative direction; AverageQuantityPerOrder is mixed/nonlinear.
managerial_meaning: How often and how much the customer purchases.
what_to_monitor: Monitor purchase frequency and volume changes over time.
causal_guardrail: Prediction signal only; no causal intervention effect is established.

typical_direction_or_pattern: Mixed: higher RecencyDays pushes toward Churn, while MedianInterpurchaseDays is nonlinear/mixed.
managerial_meaning: How recently and regularly purchase events occur.
what_to_monitor: Monitor elapsed time since last purchase and deviations from observed cadence.
causal_guardrail: Prediction signal only; no causal intervention effect is established.

typical_direction_or_pattern: Predominantly away from Churn for UniqueProducts; ProductsPerOrder is mixed/nonlinear.
managerial_meaning: Breadth of products and typical basket composition.
what_to_monitor: Monitor product breadth and basket composition changes.
causal_guardrail: Prediction signal only; no causal intervention effect is established.

typical_direction_or_pattern: Mixed/nonlinear: HasRepeatPurchaseHistory=1 generally pushes away from Churn; CustomerAgeDays is mixed.
managerial_meaning: Observable history length and repeat-purchase status in the window.
what_to_monitor: Distinguish short observable histories from established repeat-purchase histories.
causal_guardrail: Prediction signal only; no causal intervention effect is established.

typical_direction_or_pattern: Mixed: higher CancellationValue pushes toward Churn, while CancellationInvoiceRate and CancellationInvoiceCount generally push away; HasCancellation is weak/near zero.
managerial_meaning: Observed cancellation frequency and value signals.
what_to_monitor: Monitor cancellations and investigate service, delivery, payment, or process context.
causal_guardrail: Prediction signal only; no causal intervention effect is established.

typical_direction_or_pattern: Country-specific/mixed and low importance; contextual rather than a primary trigger.
managerial_meaning: Recorded country context, used primarily as descriptive context because its SHAP importance is low.
what_to_monitor: Use geography as context rather than a primary retention trigger.
causal_guardrail: Prediction signal only; no causal intervention effect is established.
